recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future modifier additions or removals should update the central source/search.html table alongside the search-modifier-code CodeSystem, but no FHIR-6279 correction is currently needed.
issue_request: FHIR-6279 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core-search change request asking that search modifier listings be consistent, with all modifiers listed in one place or all split into the respective search parameter type sections. The resolution was to list all modifiers in the summary.
initial_application: Jira comments say the work was already done for another task. No git commit or combined-branch audit commit explicitly tagged FHIR-6279 was found. Historical source around the 2015 #6342 search modifier commit already contained a central 'Modifiers are' list plus detailed modifier discussion below, indicating that the FHIR-6279 request was absorbed into broader DSTU1 search modifier maintenance.
additional_context: The current search.html source is active in the build and has been reorganized since DSTU1, notably by the 2022 modifier rewrite that introduced the current summary table. The search-modifier-code CodeSystem now defines missing, exact, contains, not, text, in, not-in, below, above, type, identifier, of-type, code-text, text-advanced, and iterate; the search page summary represents all of these, using [type] for concrete resource type modifiers and separate text rows where behavior differs.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already satisfies the issue by keeping the complete modifier list in one central summary and preserving detailed explanatory sections for the relevant modifier/type behavior.
